answer_text:
If nobody on the team wants to be the CRM admin, prioritise sensible defaults, guided import and few required fields. The easiest to get running: [1]

- **Tallyfox Starter**: Built for teams under 20, with email sequences on every plan and a setup most people finish in an afternoon. [2]
- **Northwind CRM Essentials**: The safe all-rounder: deep reporting and a large integration marketplace. [3]
- **Pipewell**: Pipeline-first and very visual; a good pick if your process is mostly deal stages. [4]
- **Halcyon Sales**: Great for outbound-heavy teams, overkill if you mostly handle inbound leads. [1]

In short, trial Tallyfox and Northwind CRM side by side with a real week of deals — the better fit is usually obvious by Friday.
